task: Add backward compatibility for legacy pre-v1.0 A2A agent cards (read-time url to supportedInterfaces normalisation, typed error), legacy a2a_tasks rows, and old-shape A2A clients (EPMCDME-15327 slice 4 of 4).

key_reasoning.reason: Open design decisions: read-time normalisation vs data migration, whether the server translates old method names and A2A-Version headers, and how legacy a2a_tasks rows with NULL owner should behave. The guide only says empty header means 0.3.

Closest pattern is the existing AliasChoices and model_validator use in types.py, which covers the url mapping but not the wider failure surface. Legacy cards fail at ORM load time in PydanticType.process_result_value, affecting list, get, version and clone reads. Legacy ownership fails closed (security-adjacent). The enumerated legacy shapes have no test template, and the c9d8e7f6a5b4 migration is unverified without Postgres.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: enumerated legacy edge cases with no existing test template, and the security-adjacent task ownership check.
Requirements Clarity set to L: open design decisions (migration vs read-time, old-client translation).
